summary: Iteration 145 - Enhanced RBAC with Risk Scoring, Permission Dependencies, and AI Role Designer (GPT-5.2). Backend: 20/21 tests passed (1 timeout on AI endpoint - acceptable). Frontend: All UI features verified - premium hero, AI Designer dialog, risk badges, dependency warnings, capability summary, permission search.

minor.issue: GPT-5.2 call can timeout (>30s) under load - acceptable per requirements

tests: GET /api/rbac/catalog returns permissions with risk field (critical|high|medium|low)
GET /api/rbac/catalog returns permissions with implies[] field
Risk distribution: critical, high, medium permissions all present
POST /api/rbac/ai-suggest returns {permissions, reasoning, role_name_suggestion, display_name_suggestion, total_suggested, invalid_dropped}
POST /api/rbac/ai-suggest drops invalid permission keys from GPT response
Critical permissions: delete_bookings, delete_users, delete_roles, approve_payroll_runs, process_refunds, view_secrets, create_roles, edit_roles
High permissions: cancel_bookings, delete_rooms, create_payroll_runs, export_audit_logs, create_users, edit_users
Premium hero with gradient and glass-morphism
AI Role Designer button with GPT-5.2 badge (data-testid=ai-designer-btn)
6 template tiles (receptionist, housekeeper, manager, accountant, laundry_staff, maintenance)
Template click loads permissions and shows capability summary
Permission search with placeholder 'Search permissions... (press / to focus)'
Search filters tree and auto-expands matching categories
Categories show animated SVG ring progress + selected/total count
Category Select all / Clear links work
Risk badges: CRITICAL (red), HIGH (amber), MEDIUM (sky blue)
Dependency warning banner when missing implies (data-testid=dep-warning)
Fix all button adds missing dependencies (data-testid=fix-deps-btn)
Sticky save bar with count and save/cancel buttons
GPT-5.2 response shows in emerald card (data-testid=ai-result)
Shows 'GPT-5.2 picked N permissions' with reasoning
Plain-English description: 'Users with this role get full access to X, Y (N/M)...'
Shows 'Blocked from: ...' for categories with 0 permissions

critical_code_review_comments: PERMISSION_RISK dict correctly maps ~80 destructive/sensitive permissions to critical/high/medium risk levels
PERMISSION_IMPLIES dict correctly maps ~70 permissions to their dependencies
enrich_catalog() function properly merges risk and implies into each permission
AI suggest endpoint correctly uses emergentintegrations.llm.chat.LlmChat with model('openai','gpt-5')
AI suggest correctly filters out invalid permission keys from GPT response
Frontend correctly shows risk badges only for risk != low
Frontend correctly detects missing dependencies and shows warning banner
Frontend Fix all button correctly adds all missing dependencies
All data-testid attributes are in place for automated testing
seed_data_creation: Test roles created during backend testing were cleaned up (test_iter145_*, test_get_*, test_update_*, test_clone_*, test_delete_*).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 145 added risk scoring (PERMISSION_RISK ~80 entries), permission dependencies (PERMISSION_IMPLIES ~70 entries), and AI Role Designer (GPT-5.2 via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY). GET /api/rbac/catalog now returns enriched permissions with risk and implies fields. POST /api/rbac/ai-suggest (admin only) calls GPT-5.2 to suggest permissions from plain-English description. Frontend shows risk badges (CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM), dependency warnings with Fix all button, capability summary, and AI Designer dialog. All data-testid attributes are in place.
